legacy_inventory.local_acceptance_note: Existing converted candidate files remain review material only. This register accepts seven official GOV.SI links for scoped external use and offers the whole PISRS legal portal for human review of its current consolidated records. No local copy, converted text, topic, or country review is accepted.

policy: Official GOV.SI service pages are usable links within their displayed dates and stated scopes. PISRS is the official national legal-information portal; its government-published consolidated texts are suitable working references with the displayed edition and informational label. Because this review client receives only a JavaScript shell for the PISRS records, offer the whole official PISRS site for human review of the listed records. API authorization applies only to automated API access; no API call, Gazette-fragment reconstruction, local capture, hash, replay, conversion, or copying permission is required for ordinary link use. Check a specific later amendment only when it may materially affect the issue. Link acceptance is separate from local-copy acceptance, topic coverage, and country completion.

si_22.publisher: GOV.SI, Government of the Republic of Slovenia; page content assigned to the Ministry of the Interior and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs
si_22.scope: Central official guidance and discovery page for entry, residence, EU/EEA nationals, Swiss nationals, visas, and related services.
si_22.reviewed_content: The page separates EU citizens, their family members, EEA extension, Swiss nationals, and third-country nationals, and links to residence, visa, privacy, and service pages.
limitations: Guidance and linked pages are not a substitute for the law. Keep the EU/EEA route distinct from the separately described Swiss Agreement route.
The page and its attachments change; rediscover current services and forms from this parent when needed.
This link decision accepts reference use only, not a local copy or topic coverage.

si_23.publisher: GOV.SI, Government of the Republic of Slovenia; Ministry of the Interior and Public Administration
si_23.version_or_cutoff: Service page displays last change 4 June 2026.
si_23.scope: Official procedure and linked forms for an EU citizen residence-registration certificate.
si_23.reviewed_content: The page identifies the administrative unit as competent, summarizes residence purposes and evidence, and links the application and signature-capture forms.
limitations: The service page is for EU citizens; the central parent page states the relevant Foreigners Act provisions extend to EEA citizens and their family members. Verify the specific route before applying that extension.
The linked forms are mutable; use the current attachment from the service page.
This does not establish complete statutory coverage or accept a local copy.

si_24.publisher: GOV.SI, Government of the Republic of Slovenia; Ministry of the Interior and Public Administration
si_24.version_or_cutoff: Service page displays last change 4 June 2026.
si_24.scope: Official service guidance and application forms for third-country family members of an EU or Slovenian citizen.
si_24.reviewed_content: The page identifies the competent administrative unit, summarizes entry/residence periods and supporting evidence, sets out listed family categories and links to the application and signature-capture forms.
limitations: The page groups EU-citizen and Slovenian-citizen sponsor routes; their legal bases and any returning-citizen rules must be distinguished.
Treat this as government guidance, not a complete legal definition or a topic-completeness finding.
Attachments may change; this link decision does not accept a local copy.

si_25.publisher: GOV.SI, Government of the Republic of Slovenia; Ministry of the Interior and Public Administration
si_25.version_or_cutoff: Service page displays last change 4 June 2026.
si_25.scope: Official service guidance for an EU citizen permanent-residence registration certificate.
si_25.reviewed_content: The page summarizes the general five-year route and listed early-acquisition cases, identifies the competent administrative unit, and links to the signature-capture form.
limitations: The listed rules are guidance; check the governing PISRS text and the specific family-member route. The central page describes the EEA extension.
The attachment is mutable and should be rediscovered from the page.
This does not accept a local copy or complete permanent-residence coverage.

si_27.publisher: GOV.SI, Government of the Republic of Slovenia; Ministry of the Interior and Public Administration
si_27.version_or_cutoff: Service page displays last change 4 June 2026.
si_27.scope: Official service guidance and linked forms for Swiss nationals, their family members, and specified service providers.
si_27.reviewed_content: The page identifies the competent administrative unit, links separate application forms, and expressly grounds the residence route in the EU–Swiss Agreement on Free Movement of Persons.
limitations: Keep this Agreement route distinct from EU and EEA routes; the page does not establish the full rights of each family category.
Attachments may change; use the current forms from the service page.
This does not accept a local copy or complete the Swiss-route topic.

si_28.publisher: GOV.SI, Government of the Republic of Slovenia; Ministry of the Interior and Public Administration
si_28.scope: General official overview of administrative procedure and its relationship to special procedures.
si_28.reviewed_content: The page describes general procedural safeguards and expressly states that subject-specific statutes may set different rules which take priority for the matters they govern.
limitations: This is explanatory guidance, not a decision-specific deadline or remedy analysis.
Check the applicable current statute and special immigration provisions for each issue.
This does not accept a local copy or complete procedural coverage.

si_33.publisher: GOV.SI, Government of the Republic of Slovenia; Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs
si_33.version_or_cutoff: Dynamic official directory checked 21 October 2026; no last-updated date displayed.
si_33.scope: Discovery directory for Slovenian embassies, permanent representations, and consulates by country.
si_33.reviewed_content: The page identifies the categories of diplomatic representations and directs users to country records for post contacts and consular responsibility.
limitations: A directory does not establish which mission accepts a specific application, local documents, appointments, fees, or outsourced-provider arrangements.
Use the relevant country/post page for current practice.
This does not accept a local copy or establish mission-wide coverage.

historical_or_not_current_references.reason: The official eUprava pages state that they have not yet been renewed and will redirect to the old eUprava site. Keep as dated navigation/eligibility leads only; do not use them alone for current legal-aid eligibility. Check the current ZBPP text and live service.
PISRS developer documentation requires authorization for API access. This blocks API use only; it does not block manual browsing or use of public PISRS records.
OPSI CC BY 4.0 applies to its basic regulation-metadata dataset, not to full PISRS legal texts.

human_review_site_offers.offer: Offer the complete official PISRS site for a human reviewer to open the listed legal records and select the clearly identified government-published consolidated version. The pages are JavaScript shells in this review client, but the official record routes and search leads are identified. Do not require API registration or Gazette-by-Gazette reconstruction for ordinary link use.
human_review_site_offers.review_scope: For each listed legal record, confirm act identity and the displayed consolidated edition or NPB/use date, retain PISRS’s informational-status label, and use the official consolidated text as the working reference. Check a Gazette item only for a specific material amendment, commencement question, or discrepancy. If a record route has changed, rediscover it through the official PISRS site; if no useful consolidation is exposed, offer the relevant official page for human review.

human_review_site_offers.site_name: GOV.SI — entry, residence, services, attachments and missions
human_review_site_offers.offer: Offer the official GOV.SI entry/residence pages, linked services and attachments, and relevant mission pages for human review when the specific permanent-family service, current form, applicant-location procedure, appointment route, or mission representation is needed.
human_review_site_offers.review_scope: Confirm the applicable EU/EEA, Swiss, EU-family, or Slovenian-national route; follow current page attachments; identify the responsible mission for the applicant’s location and review its current checklist, filing channel, appointments, fees, and any service provider. One mission’s practice does not establish the network-wide rule.
